description: Choose the Claude Code account of a pane: `global` follows the global account (it runs on ~/.claude and switches with it, with no restart), an account id pins the pane there (on ~/.claude while that account is global, on its folder otherwise). When Claude Code has to run elsewhere for that (the account must be signed in), it moves: it stops and starts again there, resuming its conversation (copied there if the account doesn't share conversations). Pinning a pane on ~/.claude to the account that is global now restarts nothing. An idle pane moves now (looked at again right before it stops); one that is working or waiting moves once its turn ends (`after_turn`). Choosing what it already is changes no process, and cancels a move that waits (`cancelled`).

account.description: `global` (follow the global account) or an account id (pin to it).

oneOf.description: It follows the global account, which it already runs on (or Claude Code is not running).
It is pinned to the account it already runs on (or Claude Code is not running).
Claude Code was idle and now runs on the account.
Claude Code is working or waiting: it moves once its turn ends.
A move that waited for the turn was called off.

account.description: The account it runs on now, or will after its turn.
